title: Macrocosm
summary: MAC'ROCOSM, noun [Gr. great, and world.] The great world; the universe, or the visible system of worlds; opposed to microcosm, or the world of man.

inlines.v: MAC'ROCOSM, noun [Gr. great, and world.] The great world; the universe, or the visible system of worlds; opposed to microcosm, or the world of man.
